results.title: Opposition parties up in arms against CM Vijay’s Karnataka visit plan
results.description: AMMK general secretary T T V Dhinakaran also opposed the reported visit, saying it would serve no purpose as Karnataka had openly rejected the CWMA’s direction.

results.title: Five Toronto police officers found guilty of misconduct for comments on Muslim outreach podcast
results.description: On one episode, the uniformed hosts praised October 7 as a catalyst for an ‘unbelievable’ number of converts to Islam, and downplayed support for Hamas at anti-Israel rallies
